segments.name: Recycled electronics
segments.description: Sources pre-owned consumer electronic devices from developed countries and resells them to wholesalers, retailers and renters in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong.
segments.evidence: Based on management's assessment, the Company determined it has one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Wholesalers, retail consumers and rental clients in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong pay the company for pre-owned consumer electronic devices it sources from suppliers in the U.S., Japan and other developed countries.
revenueModel.evidence: Wholesalers of consumer electronic devices in Southeast Asia and other areas first send their inquiries containing the number and specifications of the consumer electronic devices needed.
